title: SimpliSafe Alarm Event Alarm Type Leaderboard
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplisafe:event alarm_type=*
| stats sum(alarm_type) as total_value, avg(alarm_type) as avg_value by sensor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sensor values by total and average alarm type across SimpliSafe alarm event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `alarm_type` values for each SimpliSafe alarm event event and review total and average alarm type by sensor.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total alarm type.
grandmaExplanation: It calmly which sensor shows the biggest alarm type numbers in your SimpliSafe alarm event data.
